request.text: What is the current on AM1?

solution.item: Solution by TINA assisted by AI
First we calculate the total resistance between the generator nodes (IS1)
Now we calculate the current on R1

We know that the voltage between IS1 nodes is 10 Volt, because the generator current is Igen = 10mA and the resistance between the generator nodes is Rtot = 1kOhm so the voltage between the generator nodes is Igen*Rtot = 10 Volt
The components R1 connected in parallel. The voltage on R1 is 10 Volt because the voltage on Rb is 10 Volt
The current on R1 is the voltage on R1/R1 = 10m Amper
To answer the original question: because the AM1 ampermeter connected to R1 in series so the current on AM1 is 10m Amper
